expires_today.title: Dying Earth RPG Collection
expires_today.long_description: Enter a decadent world of wit and danger with The Dying Earth Roleplaying Game. Drawn from the classic tales of fantasy titan Jack Vance, prime inspiration for the settings, moods and spells of Dungeons & Dragons, and designed by roleplaying legend Robin D. Laws.  Explore a wondrous, exhausted world. Trade pleasantries with its ravenous and articulate creatures. Match wits with rogues, merchants and arch-magicians, and pray your tongue is the sharper.  The entire game line of rules, settings, maps and lore, yours for the merest pittance! Before the flickering sun winks out for good and takes this bundle with it.  And should prying fools dare question you, explain that your purchase is motivated not by greed for absurdly good and fleeting bargains, but by pure charitable feeling toward the World Wildlife Fund.

expires_today.title: Complete Design Studio
expires_today.long_description:
Turn your imagination and inspiration into a thoughtful blueprint for your home’s future this summer with the ultimate home design bundle from Richdale Ventures! Unlock professional-grade personal CAD software that helps you reimagine every inch of your property, from the bathroom to the backyard. Save big on ArchiMaster 3D, the hottest home-design platform, before this amazing deal disappears, and help support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31st, 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: Love Letter to Lovecraft
expires_tomorrow.description: Our love letter to Lovecraftian gaming
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
With blood dripping from our hands, we present the Love Letter to Lovecraft Bundle. Fight to rebuild what was lost as one of the last humans living in Remnant: From the Ashes, a soulslike action-adventure rooted in Eldritch themes. Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares imaginable before you go insane in Forgive Me Father 2 Deluxe Edition, a hand-drawn Lovecraftian boomer shooter. Or maybe psychological horror is your thing—investigate the mysterious and tragic death of the Hawkins family in Call of Cthulhu. Pay what you want for thrilling experiences in gaming and help support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Humble 15th Anniversary - Ready Player One ... and Two
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
We wouldn’t be where we are today without our friends (you!!), and to celebrate that friendship as well as our 15th Anniversary, we’ve compiled a bundle of our favorite games to play solo or with a bestie. As such, the low price tier of this bundle gets you one copy of each game, and the high tier gets you two—and saves you $4! Keep the beats bumping and the beatdowns coming in street fighting beat-’em-up Streets of Rage 4! Separate your real friends from their mimics in survival horror game Mimesis! Battle against the genetically engineered zeds in Killing Floor 3! Grab these games and more for yourself and/or a buddy for the price of your choice, and help support REVERB’s green music movement with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Cyberpunk Audio Cache
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Game developers, rejoice! Crack open a cache of A+ cyberpunk audio assets so the neon signs you create hum within the rich symphony of an illuminated super city. A finely tuned audioscape sets the tone for your project, so don’t sacrifice quality for quantity—unlock this bundle and get the best of both worlds! Pay what you want for audio packs like Signal Bleed, Vol. 1, Urban Exploration, Vol. 1 Audio Pack, and Combat - Full Assault, Vol. 1 Audio Pack—and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

This bundle contains content created with or partially created with A.I. tools

expires_tomorrow.title: The Master Forge MAX-Savings STL Pack 2026
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Save big on the hottest printable 3D fantasy models from the comfort of your own home with the all-new Humble Bundle x Master Forge collection! Choose from 75+ printables, including giants, woodland monsters, Viking ships, animal companions, and more! Perfect for any fantasy story or campaign, you can start planning epic journeys for your personalized characters with limitless possibilities. Pay what you want for this amazing bundle today and help support DonorsChoose with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete RPG Creator Bundle - 2D, GUI & Audio Assets
expires_tomorrow.description: Make your own RPGs with ease!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Streamline your RPG development cycle with ready-to-use 2D, GUI, and audio assets! Focus your creative energy on storytelling and characters—leave the assets to us. Choose from 75+ packs that remove friction and accelerate your project, like the Mana Seed Pixel Art Tileset Collection, Game Fantasy GUI Kit, 2D Fantasy Characters Kit, and more. Pay what you want for professional-quality assets from GameDev Market and help support Canine Companions with your purchase!

The license agreement can be found here.

expires_tomorrow.title: Built Differently: Builder Games
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Grab your hardhat and shovel because it’s time to clock in at the Built Differently: Builder Games Bundle! Save big on the Game of the Year Edition of Frostpunk, the society-first survival builder where you roleplay as ruler of the last city on Earth. Will you rule with an iron fist? Or build your empire on a foundation of lies? The choices are yours. Or unearth great games like Diplomacy Is Not an Option and Drill Core from this 10-title collection. Plus, your hard work helps support the Her Future Coalition!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 4th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Builder’s Vault by Hivemind - Unreal Engine Edition
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Level up your asset library with The Builder’s Vault Collection of detailed environmental assets specifically designed for Unreal Engine. These ready-to-use environmental assets are designed specifically for Unity by the creatives at Hivemind. Make games faster with modular assets that plug and play with your existing tools for frictionless creation at any skill level. Pay what you want for access to themed packs like Toskov: Post Apocalyptic City Megapack, Ravenhold: Modular Dark Fantasy Megapack, and more. Speed through your next development process with elite environmental assets and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before August 22th, 2027. Professional Fab Marketplace keys provided.
